description: manage bare-metal machines through their BMCs (Redfish) and the pk-metal operator that runs in a Kubernetes cluster.

commands.name: status
commands.summary: show machines, BMCs, claims and operations, with the reason when something is stuck (reads only)

commands.name: check
commands.summary: test that a BMC answers and list its virtual media and systems (reads only)

commands.name: inventory
commands.summary: read the hardware inventory from a BMC and print it as YAML (reads only)

commands.name: render
commands.summary: write Talos machine configs, talosconfig and kubeconfig from TalosCluster and TalosNode files (touches no machine)

commands.name: relay
commands.summary: run on a host that can reach the BMCs: BMCs download boot media from it, and it forwards that traffic to pk-metal boot

commands.name: sim
commands.summary: run simulated BMCs for tests: serve one, or a fleet with a virtual machine behind each

commands.name: version
commands.summary: print the version of this program

commands.name: top
commands.summary: live view of every machine: BMC, phase, operation, node; keys approve, hold and retry like the commands below

commands.name: approve
commands.summary: show what a proposed operation will do to a machine, then let it run; several names: one plan and one answer each; without a name, list the operations that wait for approval

commands.name: retry
commands.summary: delete a failed or aborted operation, so that the operator proposes it again (it then waits for approval again); a BIOS or firmware proposal is marked for retry instead

commands.name: abort
commands.summary: stop an operation before its next step and undo what it left behind (media, boot override, cordon)

commands.name: reboot
commands.summary: propose a clean reboot of a Talos node: cordon, drain, reboot, wait until ready, uncordon (waits for approval)

commands.name: hold
commands.summary: stop the operator from proposing new operations for a claim; nothing on the machine changes

commands.name: unhold
commands.summary: remove a hold, so that the operator proposes operations for the claim again

commands.name: backup
commands.summary: take an etcd snapshot now, list the snapshots, download one, or decrypt one on this machine

commands.name: restore
commands.summary: say what is wrong with a cluster's etcd and propose the operations that restore it; upload an approved snapshot

commands.name: wipe
commands.summary: ask for a wipe of a released machine that may still hold a node's install (the operator proposes it)

commands.name: reinstall
commands.summary: ask for the node a claim runs to be wiped and installed again on the same machine (the operator proposes it)

commands.name: replace
commands.summary: move a node to another machine, for failed hardware: the old machine is released first (the operator proposes it)

commands.name: scale
commands.summary: show which machines a cluster gains or gives back to reach a size, and in which order; --apply makes the claims say so

commands.name: rollout
commands.summary: see the rollouts that change a Talos cluster node by node (config, upgrade, reboot), approve one, resume it after its pause, or abort it

commands.name: upgrade
commands.summary: set the Talos or Kubernetes version a cluster asks for and show the rollout the operator proposes; nothing runs before it is approved

commands.name: pivot
commands.summary: move the operator and its objects from this cluster to another one, for example from kind onto the Talos cluster it built

commands.name: boot
commands.summary: mount a machine config ISO through a BMC and REBOOT the machine into it, without the operator

commands.name: bootstrap
commands.summary: start a new Talos cluster on booted machines and wait until every node is ready, without the operator

exitStatus.meaning: error; the message is on stderr, as "pk-metal: <message>"
pk-metal status only: something is blocked or failed and needs a person
